## Capabilities

- **Email & Lifecycle Marketing** — End-to-end lifecycle programs on GoHighLevel, Mailchimp, HubSpot, and Kajabi. Campaign builds, audience segmentation, automated nurture and retention flows, multi-touch sequences, A/B split tests on subject lines and content, and open/click/delivery analytics reporting.
- **CRM Configuration & Automation** — GoHighLevel full builds, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Kajabi, ActiveCampaign. Sub-accounts, pipelines, workflows triggered by tags and custom fields, pages in the GHL website/funnel builder, A2P 10DLC SMS brand approval (the GHL setup most builders avoid).
- **Deliverability & Compliance** — Dedicated sending subdomains with SPF/DKIM/DMARC aligned, warmup to 6,500/day sending capacity, A2P 10DLC SMS registration, pre-send QA (test sends, link + unsubscribe checks, phone preview).
- **Workflow Automation & AI** — n8n (designed a 47-node lead-generation workflow as a personal project), Google Apps Script automations, Anthropic Claude API for personalized outreach drafting, multi-provider email enrichment. GoHighLevel API + Google Sheets API integrations.
- **Custom Sites & Internal Tools** — Hand-coded HTML/CSS/JS on Cloudflare Pages, React + Vite + Firebase internal tools. Recently built AGC HUB — a custom platform that brings a US agency's work from 5 tools (Drive, ClickUp, Trello, GHL, Canva) into one app. In daily production. Also built the agency's in-house email/SMS platform (Cloudflare Workers + D1, React, Resend, Twilio), which is now replacing GoHighLevel, and integrated Square payments through the Square API on a Cloudflare-hosted client site.

It is now replacing GoHighLevel.
